rows.he: אֶשָּׂא דֵעִי בְּצֶדֶק. תֵּת לְפוֹעֲלִי צֶדֶק. אֶשְׁאֲלָה מִשְׁפְּטֵי צֶדֶק. קוֹל לְהָרִים כַּשּׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: I meditate on righteousness to ascribe righteousness to my Creator; I ask for judgments of righteousness and raise my voice like a Shofar.

rows.he: אֵין קוֹרֵא בְצֶדֶק. רוֹדֵף צֶדֶק צֶדֶק. אֶקְרָא שִׁמְעָה צֶדֶק. בְּקוֹל בָּלוּל כַּשּׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: When none proclaims in righteousness and none pursues righteousness, I call out for a hearing in righteousness in a voice mingled with the Shofar.

rows.he: בַּנְתִּי בְמַדָּעִי. לְמֵרָחוֹק שְׂאֵת דֵעִי. בִּטּוּי תְּרוּעָה בְּיָדְעִי. בְּקוֹל מַתַּן שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: I understood through my knowledge when I raised my mind far distant and know that the utterance of Teruah sounded at the Revelation through the Shofar.

rows.he: בּוֹ בְהָרִיעִי. אֲרַצֶּה לִי רוֹעִי. בְּאָמְצוֹ זְרוֹעִי. בְּקוֹל כֹּחַ שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: By blowing Teruah I appease my shepherd, who strengthens my arm through the powerful sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: גַּשְׁתִּי בְּיוֹם דִּין. לְהִתְוַכֵּחַ בַּדִּין. גּוֹלֶה עֹמֶק הַדִּין. בְּקוֹל קִפָּאוֹן שֹׁפָר:
rows.en: I approached on the day of justice to plead for myself with justice; He reveals the depths of justice through the curdling sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: גְּזֵרַת דָּת וָדִין. אִם חִיַּבְתִּי בַּדִּין. גְּרוֹנִי יְעַכֵּב מוֹרַע דִּין. בְּקוֹל עִם שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: If I am guilty in justice according to the decree of law and justice, may my throat restrain the severity of justice through my voice together with the Shofar.

rows.he: דְּרֹשׁ וְהַעַל רְטִיָּה. לִפְנֵי טְרִיָּה. דַּעַת לִטְרוּיָה. קוֹל חֲבֵשׁ שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Seek out and bring healing for the wound, let the mind of the wounded people be soothed by the sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: דָּחוּי לִכְרוּיָה. בְּעַד נִבְרִיָּה. דְּרוֹר לְכָל בְּרִיָּה. בְּקוֹל הַעֲבָרַת שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Let freedom for the banished, who are sold to a strange people, and for every human creature be granted through the sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: הָכְשַׁל בְּנַאֲפוּף. בְּזָרַת גִּפּוּף. הֻצַּג בְּרִיב צָפוּף. בְּקוֹל חֶרְדַּת שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: He who has sinned in adultery, through the embrace of the strange woman, and is led, penned up in judgment, dreads the sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: הָעֳנַשׁ בְּאַפּוּף. וְשָׁב הֱיוֹת חָפוּף. הוֹעִילוֹ לֵב כָּפוּף. בְּקוֹל כְּפִיפַת שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: He who was punished in anger and repents to be purified, his bent heart avails him at the sound of the bent Shofar.

rows.he: וְאִם שׁוֹד יַעַלְזוֹ. וּבַדִּין יְלִיזוֹ. וְצֶדֶק יָרוּץ לְאָחֲזוֹ. בְּקוֹל חִיל שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: If the evil impulse had tempted him and he is accused in justice, clemency hastens to hold him up at the tremulous sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: וּכְמוֹ מַכְנִים בְּזוֹ. וּמוֹצִיא בְּזוֹ. וְכֵן מֶנּוּ יְגִיזוֹ. בְּקוֹל רוּחַ שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Just as the sound passed through the Shofar, so does the Lord cut short the speech of the accuser at the breath of the sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: זֶה מִכָּל קוֹלוֹת. אֲשֶׁר בְּמַקְהֵלוֹת. זִקֵּק לִקְהִלּוֹת. קוֹל תֵּקַע שֹׁפָר:
rows.en: Of all the sounds that are heard in assemblies, He has made incumbent on communities the sound of the blast of the Shofar.

rows.he: זֹמְמֵי עֲקַלְקַלֹּת. מְחֻיְּבֵי סְקִילוֹת. זָעוּ בְּגִדּוּעַ מַקְלוֹת. בְּקוֹל שֵׁמַע שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: They who planned crooked deeds, deserving of death by stoning, trembled when the cedars broke at the report of the sound of the Shofar (on the day of the Revelation).

rows.he: חַי מִכָּל שָׁנָה. יוֹם זֶה שִׁנָּה. חָקוּק לְשׁוֹשַׁנָּה. לְקוֹל חֵרוּת שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: The Eternal of every year has set apart this day from the whole year and appointed it for the Rose (Israel) for a proclamation of freedom through the sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: חִבָּתוֹ מִשְׁנֶה. שְׁנִיָּה מֵרִאשׁוֹנָה. חֵטְא כָּל הַשָּׁנָה. דְּחוּת בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: There will be extraordinary love greater than the previous love; the sin of the whole year is banished by the sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: טֶבַע בְּרָכוֹת תֵּשַׁע. מוּל שׁוֹפָרוֹת תֵּשַׁע. טָהוֹר מֵהֶם יִשַּׁע. בְּקוֹל דַּת שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: The form of the nine benedictions corresponds to the nine Shofar blasts; in His purity He allows them to entreat through the prescribed sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: טֶנֶף צְחוּנֵי רֶשַׁע. בְּשׁוּבָם מִפֶּשַׁע. טְרִיָּתָם תְּשַׁעֲשַׁע. בְּקוֹל שֶׁוַע שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Even those stained with evil, when they repent of transgression, Thou dost soothe their wound at the sound of the cry of the Shofar.

rows.he: יִיטַב מִשּׁוֹר פָּר. וּמֵאֵיל הַמְּשֻׁפָּר. יוֹם הַמְּסֻפָּר. לְקוֹל חִדּוּשׁ שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Better than the sacrificial bullock and the splendid ram is the day appointed for the sound of renewal of the Shofar.

rows.he: יֵקֶשׁ יוּפַר. וְסוֹטֵן יְחֻפַּר. יֹשֶׁר לֵב יְשֻׁפַּר. בְּקוֹל שִׁפּוּר שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: The evil impulse is broken and the accuser disgraced and the upright heart refreshed at the sound of beauty of the Shofar.

rows.he: כְּעֵת הֵם תֹּקְעִים. גֵּיא מַבְקִיעִים. כְּרַכִּים מַשְׁקִיעִים. בְּקוֹל שְׁאוֹן שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: When once they blew the Shofar (before Jericho), they cleaved asunder the valley; they caused cities to sink through the tumult of the sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: כָּל הֲמוֹן מְרֵעִים. בְּחִיל מִתְרוֹעֲעִים. כַּאֲשֶׁר הֵם מַתְרִיעִים. קוֹל יָרִיעַ כַּשּׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: All the multitude of the wicked will shake with trembling when they cry out aloud with a sound as piercing as the Shofar.

rows.he: לְקוֹלוֹ כְּיֻקְשַׁב. יָבְעַת כָּל מוֹשָׁב. לְאֻמִּים בְּסַעַר יְנַשֵּׁב. בְּקוֹל סַעֲרַת שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: When His voice is heard, every settlement is terrified, He blows away peoples in a hurricane through the stormy sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: לְיוֹדְעָיו יוּשַׁב. לְאוֹת טוֹב יִתְחַשֵּׁב. לְעֵת יִתְיַשֵּׁב. בְּקוֹל טַעַם שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: For those who know Him, there is comfort, it is reckoned a good sign for the establishment of peace through the pleasant sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: מוֹאֲסָיו לְהַבְקִיעַ. בּוֹגְדָיו לְקַעְקֵעַ. מוֹרְדָיו לְהַשְׁקִיעַ. בְּקוֹל חִזּוּק שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: They who reject Him will be cut down, the faithless will be uprooted, rebels will sink down through the powerful sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: מַאֲרִיךְ בְּהִתָּקֵעַ. מְקַצֵּר בְּהִבָּקֵעַ. מֵרִיעַ וְתוֹקֵעַ. בְּקוֹל שִׁלּוּשׁ שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: It sounds long drawn-out blasts and then short sharp notes, Teruah and Tekiah are included in the threefold sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: נוֹתֵן אֵימוֹת. מַחְפִּיז אֻמּוֹת. נוּסוּ נוֹאֲמוֹת. מִקּוֹל בּוֹךְ שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: It spreads fear, shakes nations so that they speak of flight from the menacing sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: נוֹתֵץ חוֹמוֹת. מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת. נוֹהֵם כַּהֲמוֹת. קוֹל שַׁאַג שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: It tears down walls and makes an end of wars, like the roaring of the waves is the roaring sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: סוֹדוֹ כְּגִלָּה. בְּסִין לְסֶגֻלָּה. סִים מְגִלָּה. בְּקוֹל הִלּוּךְ שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: When the Lord revealed His will to His own people on Mount Sinai, the Revelation concluded with the long drawn out sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: סוֹד יוֹם גְּאֻלָּה. בְּחָסְפּוֹ לִדְגוּלָה. שָׂשׂוֹן וְגִילָה. קוֹל יַשְׁמִיעַ שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: When once the secret of redemption will be revealed to those exalted, jubilation and rejoicing He will proclaim through the sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: עָשׂוֹר דּוֹחֶה. עֹנֶג מַדְחֶה. עֲבֵרוֹת מְמַחֶה. בְּקוֹל צֶרַח שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: On the tenth of Tishri was it sounded, even on the day of the Sabbath rest, sins were obliterated through the ringing sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: עֲוֹנוֹת מוֹחֶה. עַבְדוּת מְאַחֶה. עֲבוֹדוֹת מַנְחֶה. קוֹל חִצּוּר שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Sins are annulled and slavery is lifted and works are restored through the embracing sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: פַּגֵּר וְהַסְעִיר. מַמְלְכוּת שָׂעִיר. פִּשְׁעָהּ תָּעִיר. בְּקוֹל קוֹלוֹת שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Destroy and cast away the realm of Seir, remember its transgression at the reverberating sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: פִּתְחֵי הָעִיר. תַּשְׁקִיעַ וְתַבְעִיר. פַּחַד רַב וְצָעִיר. מִקּוֹל הֶמְיַת שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Let the gates of the city sink and disappear, let fright overcome great and small at the roaring sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: צִיּוּן רֶמֶז אוֹת. שׁוֹפָרוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת. צְוָחָה בְּמִדְיָן דְּאוֹת. בְּקוֹל שִׁתּוּף שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Threefold miraculous signs, three hundred horns set up a loud lament in Midian at the accompanying sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: צִפְצְפוּ צְבָאוֹת. כְּשָׁרוּ פְּלָאוֹת. צוּר כְּעַשׂ נִפְלָאוֹת. בְּקוֹל עָרֵב שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Israel’s hosts rejoiced at witnessing the miracles when the Creator showed His might through the sweet sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: קוֹל חֲלוּשָׁה. בְּאַרְקָא חֲלָשָׁה. קֹלוֹת מַתַּן שְׁלֹשָׁה. קוֹלוֹת כְּנִתְּנוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: A slender voice descended upon earth, there were threefold sounds of thunder at the Revelation when sounds were given on the Shofar.

rows.he: קֶרֶן מְשֻׁלָּשָׁה. הַיּוֹם לְזֵכֶר אֲשַׁלְּשָׁה. קְרוֹא עוֹד שְׁלֹשָׁה. בְּקוֹל עָתוּד שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: A threefold sound of the horn will I blow this day as a symbol of the threefold call of the Shofar (at the redemption) that will one day resound from the future Shofar.

rows.he: רָחַשְׁתִּי לַעֲלִית. וְעֵינַי תְּלוּיוֹת. רְאוֹת כְּנוּס גָּלֻיּוֹת. בְּקוֹל גֹּדֶל שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: I pray to heaven and my eyes are lifted up that I may be allowed to see the gathering of the exiles at the loud sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: רְבִיעִית חַיּוֹת. לִיקוֹד לֶהֱיוֹת. רֶשֶׁף שַׁלְהֲבִיוֹת. בְּקוֹל לַהַב שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: The fourth of the wild beasts (that Daniel saw) will fall into the fire, among the sparking flames at the fiery sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: שֵׁנָה תְּעוֹרֵר. לְשַׁלֵּם גְּמוּל לְצוֹרֵר. שְׁאוֹנוֹ תְפוֹרֵר. בְּקוֹל גְּבוּרוֹת שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Thou wilt stir up sleep to pay retribution to the oppressor, and shatter his multitudes with the mighty sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: שׁוֹשָׁן תַּדְרֵר. גְּאֻלָּה תְבָרֵר. שׁוֹכְנִים תְּזוֹרֵר. בְּקוֹל הַעֲרַת שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Thou wilt free the Rose (Israel) and let redemption dawn, revive those who slumber with the rousing sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: תְּיַשֵּׁר מֵחֶרְמוֹן. לְרוֹעַ אַדְמוֹן. תַּשְׁלֵג בְּצַלְמוֹן. בְּקוֹל הֲמוֹן שׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Thou wilt march from Hermon to destroy Admon, bring cooling to Tsalmon with the massive sound of the Shofar.

rows.he: תִּצְעַד כְּבִישִׁימוֹן. בְּמַתַּן אָמוֹן. תַּשְׁמִיעַ בְּאַרְמוֹן. קוֹל קוֹרֵא כַּשּׁוֹפָר:
rows.en: Thou wilt step in our midst as once in the wilderness when Thou didst give us the Torah and once again wilt Thou allow to be heard in the Sanctuary a voice that sounds like that of the Shofar.

issues: Hebrew and English both have exactly 44 strophes. The double acrostic runs א–ת, two strophes per letter. Each strophe ends at its …שׁוֹפָר:/…שֹׁפָר: colon.

These strophes cross pages, and each is one row: 8 (HE s294→s296, EN s295→s297), 16 (HE s296→s298, EN s297→s299), 23 (HE s298→s300, EN s299→s301), 31 (HE s300→s302, EN s301→s303) and 39 (HE only, s302→s304; the English is complete on s303). In each row I joined the two pieces with a single space.
EN row 38 is one sentence, and it matches HE 38 (קֶרֶן מְשֻׁלָּשָׁה…עָתוּד). EN row 39 matches HE 39. No English strophe is missing, so no row has a null.
Every row ends on a whole word on both sides. No English sentence had to be split or merged to fit.

rows.he: אָנוּסָה לְעֶזְרָה. אֶמְצָא נֶגְדִּי. אֵל קָרוֹב לִי. בְּעֵת קָרְאִי בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: I hasten for aid and find God near me at the time when I call with my voice.

rows.he: אֲשֶׁר בַּעֲדַת אֵל. בְּקִרְבִּי נִצָּב. וּפֹה בְּמִקְדָּשׁ מְעַט. אֲצַפְצֵף לוֹ בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: In the congregation of God, He stands in my midst and here in this miniature sanctuary I mutter to Him with my voice.

rows.he: בַּקְּרֵנִי דָּרְשֵׁנִי. שֶׂה פְזוּרָה אָנִי. נִגְזַרְתִּי וְנֶאֱלַמְתִּי. בְּלִי לְהָרִים קוֹל:
rows.en: Test me, examine me, a stray sheep am I, I have been cast off and silenced so that I cannot raise my voice.

rows.he: בֶּאֱמוֹר גּוֹזְזַי. נִדָּחָה הִיא. שׁוֹמְרָהּ וְצִלָּהּ. לֹא יִשְׁאַג בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: When my shearers say ‘she is rejected’, her guardian and protector does not roar with His voice.

rows.he: גַּלְתִּי שִׂיחַ בְּחֻקָּיו. וְחִכִּי עָרֵב. הִטָּה אֹזֶן וְשָׂח. הַשְׁמִיעִנִי אֶת קוֹלֵךְ קוֹל:
rows.en: When I conversed of His statutes and my sound was pleasing, He inclined His ear and spoke; ‘Let me hear the sound of your voice’.

rows.he: גָּז וּבָרַח מֶנִּי. כְּעֹפֶר עַל הָרֵי בָתֶר. בְּבַקְּשׁוֹ דָת וָאוֹת. בְּמִשְׁכְּנוֹתַי וְאֵין קוֹל:
rows.en: Swiftly He fled from me like the deer on the rocky mountains, when He desired law and a sign from me and in my dwellings there was no voice.

rows.he: דִּלֵּג מִבֶּתֶר לְבֶתֶר. הֲשִׁיבֵהוּ אֵלַי. אוּלַי יִשָּׂא פָנֶיךָ. עֵקֶב שָׁמְעֵךְ בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: He who leapt from fragment to fragment (Abraham), let him restore Him to me, perhaps He will raise your face because you heard His voice.

rows.he: דְּרוֹשׁ טוֹבָה לָמוֹ. וּרְאֵה שֵׂה מוֹרִיָּה. אִלֵּם פִּיהוּ יְהִי צֶדֶק. לְלֹא שָׁמְעָה בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: Plead on their behalf, behold the sheep on Moriah, let his silent submission (Isaac) justify those who did not listen to His voice.

rows.he: הָסֵר מֵחָלָק. יָדַיִם שְׂעִירוֹת. הוֹגֶה בְּתַחֲנוּנִים. כִּי לְךָ הַקּוֹל:
rows.en: Keep far from the smooth one (Jacob) the hairy hands (of Esau), when he meditates on entreaties, for to Thee is his voice.

rows.he: הוֹשַׁע. אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִשָּׁכַח עֵדוּת. וּמִפִּי זַרְעוֹ. לֹא יָסוּף קוֹל:
rows.en: Grant help that the testimony should not be forgotten and from the mouth of His seed there should be no end to his voice.

rows.he: וְחוֹזַי וּמְלִיצַי. הֵם בְּנֵי אִמִּי. וְאָז נִחֲרוּ בִי. לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמַע קוֹל:
rows.en: My seers and my spokesmen, the sons of my mother, remonstrated with me that I should hear Thy voice.

rows.he: וְעַל מִשְׁמַרְתָּם. יַעַמְדוּ וְיִזְעָקוּ. וְגַל לָהֶם סוֹד. וְהוּא יַעֲנֵם בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: They stand on their watch and cry out; let the secret be revealed to them that the Lord may answer them with His voice.

rows.he: זֶה חָמַק מֶנִּי. אֲסוֹבֵב וַאֲבַקְשֶׁנּוּ. בְּכָל מָקוֹם הוּא. אָנָה אֶשָּׂא קוֹל:
rows.en: He has left me, I wander about and seek Him, He is in every place, where shall I raise my voice?

rows.he: זֵכֶר דּוֹדִי לְמַטָּה. אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם. מְלֹא כָל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ. לְמַעְלָה קוֹרְאִים בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: The fame of my Beloved is below, He is mighty on high, ‘the whole earth is full of His glory’ do they call out above with their voice.

rows.he: חֲיָלֵי מַיִם. אֲשֶׁר בָּם שְׁבִילוֹ. דִּבְּרוּ תְּמוּנָה לֹא רָאִינוּ. זוּלָתִי קוֹל:
rows.en: The soldiers in the waters through which He made a path (the Sea of Reeds) said ‘we have seen no form but only a voice’.

rows.he: חִפַּשְׂתִּי יְשִׁימוֹן הֲיֵשׁ. וְאָמְרוּ אָיִן. קֶדֶם תִּתּוֹ עֹז. בִּעֲתַנִי בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: I searched for Him in the desert and they said that He is not there, yet when of old He gave His law, He frightened me with His voice.

rows.he: טָהוֹר דִּלֵּג. הָרִים וְעָבַר. וּמִמְּעוֹן הַר מוֹר. אָז נָתַן קוֹל:
rows.en: In purity He leapt over mountains and paths and from His dwelling on Mount Moriah He once sent forth His voice.

rows.he: טִמֵּאתִי יְדִידוּת שִׁכְנוֹ וְעָלָה. לְיוֹם כֶּסֶא יָבֹא. בְּאָזְנַי קוֹל:
rows.en: When I defiled His dear dwelling, He rose up from it, on the hidden day there will come in my ears a voice.

rows.he: יָקַרְתִּי בְּעֵינָיו. וְנִלְוָה לִי בַּשְּׁבִי. עִמּוֹ אָנֹכִי. אָז הִבְטִיחַנִי בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: I was dear in His eyes and He adhered to me in captivity, ‘I am with him’ He assured me then with His voice.

rows.he: יָרַד לְשִׁנְעָר. וְשָׂם כֵּס בְּעֵילָם. הִשְׁמִיעַ כַּאֲרִי. וּכְנָחָשׁ קוֹל:
rows.en: He went down to Shinear and set up His throne in Elam, where He made heard like a lion and like a serpent a voice.

rows.he: כִּלָּה מֶנִּי דּוֹב. כְּהִתְרַפָּה מִמְּלֶאכֶת. חַק בַּמִּכְתָּב. וַיַּעֲבֶר קֹל:
rows.en: He saved me from the bear — when the work from the Sanctuary was disturbed — which had been inscribed in writing and proclaimed by a voice.

rows.he: כָּבַשׁ לִי. אַרְבָּעָה רָאשֵׁי נָמֵר. וְגַם אֲנִי בְּהוֹדָיוֹת סֶלָה. אַשְׁמִיעַ לוֹ קוֹל:
rows.en: He subdued for me the four heads of the leopard and in my gratitude I make heard to Him my voice.

rows.he: לְחַיַּת קָנֶה. אָז מָכַר אֶרֶץ. מִי לִי בַשָּׁמַיִם. אָז הֵרִימָה קוֹל:
rows.en: He then sold the land to the wild beast of the reeds, ‘who is above me in heaven?’ it boasted aloud with its voice.

rows.he: לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי. מִשִּׁנֵּי בַרְזֶל שִׁוַּעְתִּי. וּמֵרֶגֶל עַבְטִיט. הִצְרַחְתִּי בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: To the God of my salvation from the teeth of iron I cried and from before the trampling foot I shrieked with my voice.

rows.he: מִדַּת קִצִּי. לֹא הוֹדִיעַנִי. מָתַי בְּאַרְצִי. תּוֹר יַשְׁמִיעַ קוֹל:
rows.en: He has not made known to me the measure of my end, when in my land the turtle dove will make heard its voice.

rows.he: מִיּוֹדְעֵי סֵפֶר. חָתַם קִצִּי. לְבַל דַּעַת צוֹפַי. עֵת יִשְׂאוּ קוֹל:
rows.en: Even from scholars has He concealed my end, that my seers may not know the time when they will lift up their voice.

rows.he: נָא הַבֵּט וּרְאֵה. עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי. אֵין לִי מַכִּיר. לְמִי אֶשָּׂא קוֹל:
rows.en: Pray look and see my woe and my pain, there is no friend to me to whom I can raise my voice.

rows.he: נֶצַח אֲקַוֶּה. כִּי לֹא יִפֹּל דָּבָר. מִמַּקְשִׁיבֵי. דְּמָמָה וָקוֹל:
rows.en: For ever shall I hope that no word shall be omitted from those who listen for a still small voice.

rows.he: שׂוֹשׂ יָשִׂישׂ. לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי. בְּשָׁמְעִי דּוֹדִי דּוֹפֵק. עַל פְּתָחַי קוֹל:
rows.en: In my midst my heart rejoices when I hear my Beloved sounding on my doors with His voice.

rows.he: סֶלָה יְשִׂימֵנִי. כַּחוֹתָם עַל לֵב. כְּאָז תַּחַת הַתַּפּוּחַ. עוֹרְרֵנִי בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: Truly He will bear me as a seal on the heart as once when beneath the apple tree He roused me with His voice.

rows.he: עִלִּיתַנִי אֵל. עַל כָּל בָּנוֹת. כִּי בַעֲבוּרִי. בְּחוֹרֵב תַּתָּה קוֹל
rows.en: Thou hast raised me, O God, over all daughters since on my behalf on Horeb didst Thou give voice.

rows.he: עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִים מְאֹד נִתְעַלֵּיתָ. נֶצַח תִּתְעַלֶּה. בִּתְרוּעַת קוֹל:
rows.en: Over all gods art Thou greatly exalted, to eternity shalt Thou be exalted with the Teruah’s voice.

rows.he: פָּעָה מִמִּדְבָּר. צִפּוֹר מִמִּצְרַיִם. וְיוֹנָה הִשְׁמִיעָה. מֵאַשּׁוּר קוֹל:
rows.en: A bird from Egypt (Israel) cooed from the wilderness and a dove from Assyria sounded its voice.

rows.he: פְּקוֹד צִפּוֹר בַּיִת. דְּרוֹשׁ יוֹנַת אֵלֶם. תְּקַע לָמוֹ בַּשּׁוֹפָר. וּשְׁרֹק לָמוֹ בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: Take note of the bird of Thy household, seek out the patient dove, blow the Shofar for them and whistle to them with Thy voice.

rows.he: צֹר חֻקִּים מִנִּי. לְבַל יָעוּפוּ כַנֶּשֶׁר. לְבַל יִכָּנְפוּ. מַשְׁמִיעֵי קוֹל:
rows.en: Fasten Thy laws to me lest they fly away like the eagle, lest there take flight those who make heard Thy voice.

rows.he: צְרוּפָה אֶלְמַד. וְעֵינַי לְמוֹרִי. כְּאָז צִיר מְדַבֵּר. וְאֵל מְשִׁיבוֹ בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: I will learn the pure law with my eyes on my Teacher just as once His messenger (Moses) spoke and God answered him with His voice.

rows.he: קָרַב קֵץ. בָּא עֵת מִשְׁפָּט. קָם מֵלִיץ יֹשֶׁר. לְהִתְחַנֵּן בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: The end has approached, the time of judgment comes, a defender arises to entreat with his voice.

rows.he: קֻדַּשׁ חֹדֶשׁ. וְהוּכַן מוֹעֵד. וְאֶתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר. וְיַעֲנֶה לִי בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: The new moon is sanctified and the feast prepared, so let me blow the Shofar that He may answer me with His voice.

rows.he: רֶגֶשׁ מִקֶּבֶר. צְוָחָה מִסֶּלַע. בְּתֵת יְבֵשֵׁי עֶצֶם. מֵעָפָר קוֹל:
rows.en: There will be stirring from the grave, a shout from the rock when the dry bones from the dust give voice.

rows.he: רְאוּ נֵס בֶּהָרִים. וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר בָּאָרֶץ. לְהַשְׁמִיעַ רֶנֶן. מְדוּמֵּי קוֹל:
rows.en: Witness the banner on the mountains and the sound of the Shofar on earth when there is heard the exultation of those long silent of voice.

rows.he: שֶׁגֶג לֵב הוּתַל. עוֹד בַּל יַטֵּנוּ. בְּלִי לְהַכְבִּיד אֹזֶן. מִשְּׁמוֹעַ קוֹל:
rows.en: No longer shall the heart mocked by error refuse to incline, no longer shall the ear be deaf and not hear the voice.

rows.he: שׁוֹבֵב לִי כְּקֶדֶם. דַּת מוֹרָשָׁה. אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ עִלַּפְתַּנִי. בְּלַפִּידִים וָקוֹל:
rows.en: Restore to me as of old the law of my inheritance, as when Thou didst shatter me with lightning and the voice.

rows.he: תְּבוּנָה הֵפִיק. אִישׁ נְבוֹן דָּבָר. וְחַק נֹעַם זְמִירוֹת. בִּנְעִימוֹת קוֹל:
rows.en: Wisdom was uttered by one wise in words (David) who composed the pleasantest of songs with pleasantness of voice.

rows.he: תְּהִלָּה יִתֵּנוּ. אָז לַכֹּל הִשְׁמִיעַ. לָאֵל מוֹשֵׁל בַּכֹּל. יַמְתִּיקוּ בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: He taught all to give praise to God who rules over all, that they might know how to sweeten their voice.

rows.he: תַּחַת בְּנֵי צִיּוֹן. בְּנֵי יָוָן שָׁחוּ. הִבְרַקְתָּ חִצִּים. וַתְּהֻמֵּם בְּקוֹל:
rows.en: Instead of the sons of Zion the sons of Yavan were laid low, Thou didst make Thy arrows flash and confound them with a voice.

rows.he: תַּרְעֵם לְבוֹזְזַי. תִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר. בְּסַעֲרוֹת תֵּימָן. אָז יֵלֵךְ קוֹל:
rows.en: Thunder against my plunderers, blow with the Shofar, in the whirlwinds of the south let there go forth a voice.

role_placements.label: ח׳
role_placements.note: Printed directly after 'בְּחוֹרֵב תַּתָּה קוֹל' with no colon.

issues: The 46 rows follow the double acrostic, two strophes per letter. Rows 1–29 run א–נ. Row 29 (שׂוֹשׂ) and row 30 (סֶלָה) are the ס pair, with sin standing in for samekh in row 29. After that: ע 31–32, פ 33–34, צ 35–36, ק 37–38, ר 39–40, ש 41–42, ת 43–44, ת 45–46. Rows 1–30 are the main poem (anusah plus anusah_tail). Rows 31–46 are the eight two-strophe pieces.

These strophes cross pages, and each is one row: 9 (HE s294→s296, EN s295→s297), 19 (HE s296→s298, EN s297→s299) and 43 (HE s304→s306, EN s305→s307). No partial fragment is counted as a strophe of its own.

Each two-strophe piece is a two-sentence English block. I split each block at its sentence boundary into two rows (31/32 … 45/46). That boundary matches the Hebrew terminal …קוֹל: in every piece, and the printed ח׳ label in each piece falls at the same boundary.
Row 10 opens with the one-word colon 'הוֹשַׁע.' as its acrostic head (second ה strophe). The English 'Grant help' matches it, so there is no misalignment.
No row has a null translation.

weekday_verse_sequence.verse_he: וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיֹת הַבֹּקֶר וַיְהִי קֹלֹת וּבְרָקִים וְעָנָן כָּבֵד עַל־הָהָר וְקֹל שֹׁפָר חָזָק מְאֹד וַיֶּחֱרַד כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה:
weekday_verse_sequence.intro_en: As it is written in Thy Torah:
weekday_verse_sequence.verse_en: ‘And it happened on the third day during the morning that there was thunder and lightning and a heavy cloud lay over the mountain and there was a very powerful sound of the Shofar and all the people in the camp were afraid’.

weekday_verse_sequence.verse_he: וַיְהִי קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאֹד מֹשֶׁה יְדַבֵּר וְהָאֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶנּוּ בְקוֹל:
weekday_verse_sequence.verse_en: ‘And the sound of the Shofar grew very powerful, Moses was speaking and God was answering him aloud’.

weekday_verse_sequence.verse_he: וְכָל־הָעָם רֹאִים אֶת־הַקּוֹלֹת וְאֶת־הַלַּפִּידִם וְאֵת קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וְאֶת־הָהָר עָשֵׁן וַיַּרְא הָעָם וַיָּנֻעוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מֵרָחֹק:
weekday_verse_sequence.verse_en: ‘And all the people were seeing the thunder and the lightning and the sound of the Shofar and the mountain in smoke, the people saw and trembled and stood at a distance’.

weekday_verse_sequence.verse_he: עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה יְיָ בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר:
weekday_verse_sequence.intro_en: And in Thy holy words it is written saying:
weekday_verse_sequence.verse_en: ‘God has arisen with Teruah, the Lord with a Shofar sound’.

weekday_verse_sequence.verse_he: בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְיָ:
weekday_verse_sequence.verse_en: ‘with trumpets and the Shofar sound cry out before the King, the Lord’.

verses_he.81/4: תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר בַּכֶּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ:
verses_he.81/5: כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב:

issues: BIBLE PLACEMENT: I checked the stated Shabbat placement against both the candidate and the images, and it is correct. Ex 19:16 follows row 30; Ps 47:6 + 98:6 follow 32; Isa 27:13 follows 34; Ex 19:19 follows 36; Ps 81:4–5 follow 38; Isa 18:3 follows 40; Ex 20:15 follows 42; Ps 150 follows 44; Zech 9:14–15(part) + 'כֵּן תָּגֵן' follow 46.

WEEKDAY ORDER: The weekday chain, grouped after row 44, is printed in a different order from the Shabbat one: Ex 19:16, Ex 19:19, Ex 20:15, Ps 47:6, Ps 98:6, Ps 81:4–5, Ps 150, Isa 18:3, Isa 27:13, Zech 9:14–15(part), then 'כֵּן תָּגֵן'. Isa 18:3 comes before Isa 27:13 here, and Ex 19:19/20:15 come straight after 19:16. Encode it in this printed order.

ZECHARIAH 9:15: Don't label this as '9:15a' or half-verse /a. In Zech 9:15 the etnachta falls at כְּמוֹ־יָיִן, but only 'יְיָ צְבָאוֹת יָגֵן עֲלֵיהֶם' is recited. That needs a declared verse-part (e.g. zechariah/9/15/<first-word name>) plus a remainder part starting at וְאָכְלוּ in opensiddur/common/subverse.py. The colon printed after עֲלֵיהֶם is a liturgical stop, not a sof pasuq.

DUPLICATE URNS: Both alternatives print every one of these verses. Under the one-milestone-per-canonical-verse rule, a second canonical milestone in the same project is dropped with a warning. Put canonical verse milestones on one copy only. The other copy should get quote-context milestones inside seg type='quotation', or transclude the first copy. The same applies to Hayom/Areshet if they already have canonical milestones at the earlier Malkhuyot/Zikhronot occurrences: reuse those, don't duplicate them.

CITATION LABELS: The citation labels (Ex 19:16 etc.) are notes only. The intro formulas (כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְנֶאֱמַר, וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר, וְעַל־יְדֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר; As it is written…, And it was said:) are recited liturgical text.
